title: Virtual-table parser argument boundaries

scope.rationale: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE argument parsing completes the previously accumulated argument at each new argument boundary, duplicates non-empty bytes into table ownership, and resets parser accumulation for the next argument.
excluded_responsibilities: Token-span extension after the first token

external_source_responsibilities: Generated parser CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE actions
dependencies.caller_closure: Both private parser-boundary functions are assigned together and feed the existing virtual-table construction owner.

inputs: Virtual table under construction, accumulated argument bytes, and active column limit
outputs: Owned table argument or no-op for empty accumulation, followed by empty reusable accumulation
contracts.ownership: Input accumulation remains parser-owned and reusable. The table receives a duplicate released by Table.deinit exactly once.
contracts.state_and_results: Empty accumulation adds nothing. Non-empty accumulation appends one argument, enforces the column limit through addModuleArgument, then clears the parser buffer only after success.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: OOM or limit failure preserves the accumulated input for parser cleanup; successful initialization leaves it empty for the next argument.

representation_differences: A reusable ArrayList accumulation replaces source Token span fields while preserving boundary, duplicate, and reset semantics.

oracle.protocol: Accumulate empty, one-token, and multi-token arguments; cross argument boundaries; inject duplicate/append OOM and column-limit failure; compare constructor argv ordering and cleanup.
oracle.normalization: Compare argument bytes and order; pointer identities are not compared.

assurance.oom: Duplicate and append allocation failures retain cleanup ownership and do not clear input prematurely.
assurance.malformed_input: Empty accumulation is a no-op; column-limit excess returns Constraint.
assurance.continuation: Successful boundaries permit subsequent argument accumulation and final constructor argv use.
assurance.performance: One bounded duplicate and append per argument.

integration.native_call_path: The native parser actions and virtual-table construction owner share the typed argument lifecycle module; final SQL frontend argument grammar expansion remains bounded.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The no-op parser-boundary substitute is replaced in the native lifecycle owner.

independent_review.notes: Generated parser call-path integration, pinned-C trace, assurance, and independent review remain open.
